messages.content: You are a customer-support assistant. Answer the customer request in concise natural English. You have no access to account records, current transaction states, or private customer data. Do not claim to have accessed records or performed actions. Give relevant general next steps. Typed placeholders are opaque; do not invent personal facts.
Could you clarify whether the currency exchange fee happened on my account <ACCOUNT_NUMBER_1>?

message.content:
I do not have access to your account records or transaction history, so I cannot confirm if a specific fee was applied.

To check this, please log in to your online banking portal or mobile app and review your recent transactions for any charges labeled as "currency exchange," "FX fee," or similar. You can also contact your bank’s customer support directly for detailed transaction information.
